QuestInfo.name: [April Fools'] Scarrs' Prank Guide
QuestInfo.0:
#b#e<Maple World Spot the Difference>#n#k

In celebration of April Fools' Day, Mushroom Researcher Scarrs set up a fun little prank all around Maple World.
Use your observational skills to see through his tricks!
Search Maple World for his hidden mushrooms!
